messages:
carmen: Pushing a small runtime tweak named 'prefix-collapse' to canary pools now. Quick summary: canary -> prod shows p50 ~15% down, p99 ~30% down on interactive chat traces, and token unit cost ~11% lower for our standard cohort. No model changes; just a new coalescing + prefetch hint flow. :tada:

deploy-bot: canary snapshot (canary-88 -> prod):
- p50 latency: 98ms -> 83ms (-15.3%)
- p99 latency: 520ms -> 364ms (-30%)
- avg token cost: $0.0098 -> $0.0087 (-11.2%)
- error rate: 0.021% -> 0.023% (within expected variance)

ash: that delta is great. high level: what did you change? sounds like new coalescer?

carmen: short answer: two small pieces that work together: 1) a prefix-collapse step in the microbatcher that deduplicates nearly-identical short requests before kernel dispatch (model-agnostic), 2) a prefetch hint exchanged from proxy -> runtime that lets the runtime skip a remote KV fetch when the prefix is likely cached in the node. both are conservative by default to avoid p99 regressions.

vidya: any special tenant opt-outs / compatibility notes for long-context or embedding-heavy workloads?

carmen: opt-out flag: `runtime.disable_prefix_collapse=true` for tenants. Also per-pool feature flag `runtime.prefix_collapse_v1`. We've listed a compatibility note: very-long-context streaming jobs (>200k tokens) may want to opt-out due to memory touch patterns; those tenants will be defaulted off in the rollout. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/prefix-collapse (internal).

sre-bot: Health-check command we used in canary owners' runbook:
```
# compare p99 per pool between canary and prod snapshots
python infra/metrics_diff.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-88 --to prod --group pool --format short
```

ek: rollback procedure? want to wire to the release automation + alerts.

carmen: rollback via release API: `POST /release/flags/runtime.prefix_collapse_v1/disable` body `{"pool":"<pool>"}`. We added automatic rollback triggers for error-rate delta > 0.05% and p99 uplift > 15% in a 5m window. Runbook has the thresholds.

ash: can we publish a one-liner for ops and CS? include opt-out and a single stat.

carmen: drafting now: "Launched prefix-collapse (canary->prod): p50 -15%, p99 -30%, token cost -11%. Tenant opt-out: runtime.disable_prefix_collapse=true. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/prefix-collapse" :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: feature `runtime.prefix_collapse_v1` enabled on canary pools: gpu-us-west-2a, gpu-eu-central-1b. Rolling more pools in 25m if metrics stay green.

vidya: will notify CS for the opt-out guidance. thanks!

ash: small ask: when you post the graphs, can you include the distribution of batch sizes and the KV remote-hit ratio pre/post? useful for the infra folks.

carmen: yes, will attach those charts in the follow-up post. big thanks to the coalescer + proxy-prefetch crews. :party_parrot:
